audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup is absent, and the page names the wrong ability in its place. Doom 'n Gloom (P) fears AND INTERRUPTS DASHES, and Vex marks any nearby enemy who dashes. Riftwalk is a dash — Kassadin feeds her passive with his defining ability. The page instead credits 'Personal Space (Fear)', but Personal Space is her W and only shields and damages.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.' Riot's W text is only 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.' Kassadin R is flagged dash.

notes: This was the worst matchup of the seven. The page was built on two fabrications: 'Doom Gaze' (does not exist — the passive is Doom 'n Gloom) appeared in seven content fields, and 'Personal Space (Fear)' drove the whole full layer including focus.text, when Personal Space is a shield with no fear in it. The real mechanic — Doom 'n Gloom fears AND interrupts dashes, and Vex marks nearby dashers for bonus damage — means Kassadin's Riftwalk is the exact thing her kit is built to punish, and it was stated nowhere. spikes[1].text also invented a 'Void Stone silence'; Void Stone is Kassadin's passive and grants magic damage reduction, not silence. spikes[3].text had Shadow Surge backwards (it dashes AT a marked enemy, not to allies or turrets). Cross-layer disagreement was live here, not just stale: phases[4] and phases[5] said Vex while win[4] and win[5] said Kassadin, so the page rendered opposite answers for Level 6 and First item. focus.text is exactly 25 characters and my replacement is 24, so the applier's under-25 skip rule may drop that one edit — if it does, focus.text will still name the wrong ability and needs a manual fix.
